content.comment_body: Hello, I encountered a similar issue and contacted the local supplier, who informed me that [article_no] was an older version. I currently have [article_no]. Is it possible to place a direct order with [company_name]?

It appears your supplier may not have the latest information. The updated [product_name] units from the [article_no] series now use order numbers ending with [article_no]. Please refer to the attached excerpt from the current manual. Note that the updated [product_name] operator device also has a new order number.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have expressed confusion regarding [company_name] article numbering for [product_name] modules, especially with suffixes such as [article_no]. There is uncertainty about identifying hardware versions, their compatibility, and the correct process for ordering, highlighting a need for clearer guidance on product versioning and order details.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect comprehensive information about [company_name] product versioning, accurate order numbers, and confirmation of the most up-to-date hardware. They also look for clear advice regarding the possibility of ordering directly from [company_name].
